text.en: Chandan lives in a beautiful village with a big playground where he plays kabaddi after school. Elders gather under the banyan tree at the corner.

Chandan lives in a village. After school he plays kabaddi and other games on the big playground with his friends.
There is a banyan tree at the corner where elders sit and talk. Chandan shows us around his village.
People and places in a village are connected. A shopkeeper sells food, clothes and daily needs and also sells local products.
A road connects people living in different areas and allows easy movement of goods and services.
A health centre gives treatment for illness, and the police provide safety.
A group of people who live together and help each other is a community.
Explore your own locality and write how people and places are connected.
